predictions.claim: No supply-chain bottleneck (logic, memory, CoWoS, EUV) lasts more than 2–3 years once there's a real demand signal
predictions.speaker: Jensen Huang
predictions.notes: Testable: track which named bottleneck (EUV, HBM, CoWoS, fab capacity) is the binding constraint each year through 2029.

predictions.claim: Token cost drops by an order of magnitude every single year — Vera Rubin, then Ultra, then Feynman
predictions.speaker: Jensen Huang
predictions.notes: Most concrete, falsifiable promise in the conversation. By 2028 should see ~1000× cumulative reduction from Hopper baseline.

predictions.claim: Tool-use by agents will cause enterprise software companies (Cadence, Synopsys, Adobe, etc.) to skyrocket — not get commoditized
predictions.speaker: Jensen Huang
predictions.notes: Repeat of the All-In claim. Revenue at Cadence/Synopsys/Autodesk is the cleanest test.

predictions.claim: TPU + Trainium growth will remain a single-customer (Anthropic) story; no broader ASIC trend
predictions.speaker: Jensen Huang
predictions.notes: Falsified if a major non-Anthropic AI lab commits to TPU/Trainium for >30% of training compute.

predictions.claim: Premium-token (latency-priced) inference becomes a meaningful market segment
predictions.speaker: Jensen Huang
predictions.notes: Watch for tiered pricing announcements from OpenAI/Anthropic/Google. Groq's results inside CUDA the leading indicator.

predictions.claim: Conceding China to Huawei/SMIC results in the global south adopting a non-American AI tech stack
predictions.speaker: Jensen Huang
predictions.notes: Jensen explicitly asks Dwarkesh to revisit this exact conversation. Adoption of Chinese vs American foundation models in India/Middle East/Africa/SEA is the metric.

predictions.claim: China's algorithm advances (DeepSeek, Qwen) plus abundant 7nm + energy fully offset the EUV gap for frontier models
predictions.speaker: Jensen Huang
predictions.notes: Tests against Western labs' frontier-vs-Chinese-open-source gap over time.

predictions.claim: No new accelerator architecture beats Nvidia's current roadmap when fully simulated — that's why Nvidia doesn't run parallel architectures (Cerebras-style, Dojo-style)
predictions.speaker: Jensen Huang
predictions.notes: Implicit prediction: no wafer-scale or fundamentally-different architecture overtakes Nvidia perf-per-TCO this decade.
